IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Dunn, Armstrong, Sump, Ahern, McCune, Roach, Campbell and Alexander

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing excise tax exemptions for hands-free wireless communications devices.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to excise tax exemptions for handsfree wirelesscommunications devices; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW;adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW; and providing an effectivedate.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales of handsfree equipment for use with a wireless communications device. For thepurposes of this section, "handsfree equipment" means a speaker phone,headset, earphone, or earpiece that is designed for use with a wirelesscommunications device.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to the useof handsfree equipment for use with a wireless communications device."Handsfree equipment" has the meaning provided in section 1 of this p. 1 HB 3061act.
